notes: Four co-transmitters meet at «جميعا عن ابن فضيل»: the names written once after that are the shared tail, ending at Abu Hurayra
«- قال زهير حدثنا محمد بن فضيل، -» is Muslim's own variant naming Zuhayr's teacher in full: a variant group, not a route
The Prophet's words are repeated three times with the same chain; the repetitions are one saying, not new isnads
